rationale: S-0059-01 proposes layering active dendritic conductances (Nav1.6 + Kv3) on the t0059 bar-locked GABA + AMPA-escape substrate to test whether passive dendrites cap local depolarisation in the from-scratch architecture. The from-scratch family (t0052 - t0059) has been deprioritised; active dendritic Nav1.6 and Kv3 are being tested on the deposited Bed A in t0074 (already completed: Nav1.6 boosts firing 17 -> 66 Hz without DSI loss; Kv3 inert at three somatic densities) and on Bed B in t0078's bundled MOBO with tier-stratified densities. The from-scratch substrate's passive-dendrite question is no longer load-bearing for the project. Rejecting as stale.
